about: Sentences for a fictional photo-printing service, written after the rules existed, with the expected label decided before the rules read them. First run: 11 expected, 12 no label, 1 different ('We may raise storage prices with 60 days' notice' came out as favouring you). That exposed a ranking flaw, advance notice outranking the clause it softens, which was fixed; no phrasing was tuned on these sentences. Synthetic; no real company's terms.
preamble: Tidemark Photo Ltd. ("Tidemark", "we") runs a photo printing service.

sentences.text: We may cancel any print order at our discretion.
Tidemark will not be liable for colour differences between your screen and the print.
You keep the copyright in every photo you upload.
By uploading, you allow Tidemark to use your photos in its advertising without payment.
Prints damaged in transit will be replaced free of charge.
Storage plans renew each year automatically.
We may raise storage prices with 60 days' notice.
Uploaded photos may be scanned to detect illegal content.
You must be at least 18 years old to order prints.
We will not share your photos with anyone except the print lab that makes your order.
These Terms may be updated by Tidemark from time to time.
All claims must be brought in the courts of Examplia.
You may close your account whenever you like and download your photos first.
We collect device identifiers and use them for analytics and advertising.
Orders cannot be cancelled once printing has started.
Any dispute will be settled by arbitration in Examplia City.
You will compensate Tidemark for any costs it incurs because of photos you had no right to upload.
Tidemark makes no guarantee that the service will be available at all times.
Our liability to you will never exceed the price of the order.
We do not use your photos to train any machine-learning model.
If we change these Terms in a way that hurts you, we will email you 30 days in advance.
Unused credit expires after 12 months.
We may delete photos from free accounts after 90 days of inactivity.
Nothing in these Terms removes rights you have under consumer law.
